passages.text: I was not wholly conscious of myself, but was more keenly alive to the fire within. It was as if I were the activity, and my hands and feet were only experiments for my spirit to work upon.
passages.note: feeling fully alive; losing self-consciousness in joy

passages.text: At first I frequently ensnared many a sunny hour into working a long design. Soon I learned from self-inflicted punishment to refrain from drawing complex patterns, for I had to finish whatever I began.
passages.note: overcommitting; learning to finish what you start
